titles.romaji: Akazukin, Tabi no Tochuu de Shitai to Deau.
titles.native: 赤ずきん、旅の途中で死体と出会う。

description: The fairytale of Little Red Riding Hood is as classic as they come, a familiar delivery of cookies and wine. But on this particular journey, Little Red Riding Hood... encounters a dead body?! As the mystery begins to unfold, familiar faces from other fairytales such as "Cinderella," "Hansel and Gretel," and "Sleeping Beauty" bring their own countless twists and tricks. Will she be able to solve the larger puzzle at the center of it all? A new detective is born!
